topic: Return Type Deduction with auto in Modern C++
explanation: In modern C++ (C++11 and beyond), the 'auto' keyword allows the compiler to automatically deduce the return type of functions based on their return statements. This feature simplifies code by eliminating the need to explicitly specify complex or verbose return types, especially when working with templates, iterators, or lambda expressions. It enhances code readability and maintainability by enabling more generic and flexible function definitions.
keywords: auto return type, C++ return type deduction, auto function return
